name: g4.GetScreenshot
title: Capture The Virtual Desktop
description: Captures the virtual desktop once and returns an overview followed by native-resolution detail images. Each image is immediately preceded by metadata containing its one-based imageNumber. g4.ConvertScreenshotPoint owns all coordinate conversion; callers copy imageNumber and select a pixel but never calculate or supply geometry, scaling, origin, DPI, or physical coordinates.

metricsOnly.description: When true, skips the pixel capture and returns only virtual-desktop bounds.

width.description: Exact width of the overview, or of the sole native view when no overview is needed. Informational only; g4.ConvertScreenshotPoint owns conversion.

height.description: Exact height of the overview, or of the sole native view when no overview is needed. Informational only; g4.ConvertScreenshotPoint owns conversion.

originX.description: Captured virtual-desktop horizontal origin. Informational only; callers must not use it for conversion.

originY.description: Captured virtual-desktop vertical origin. Informational only; callers must not use it for conversion.

views.description: Metadata for each returned image content block in identical one-based imageNumber order. The same metadata immediately precedes its image. Use the overview for reasoning and a detail image for precise grounding.
